editorial:
If you love non-stop action and high-stakes missions, this one grabs you right from the start. You follow an elite CIA team led by a fast-talking, intense operative named James Silva as they try to move a mysterious asset through dangerous streets. The asset holds secrets that could save thousands of lives, but getting him to safety means surviving 22 miles of chaos. The vibe is gritty, loud, and always on edge, with quick cuts and sharp dialogue that keep you locked in.

The action scenes are the real star here, especially the close-combat fights that feel raw and brutal. Mark Wahlberg brings his usual tough-guy energy, and Iko Uwais steals scenes with incredible martial arts skills. On the downside, the plot can feel messy and the characters are hard to connect with emotionally. Still, if you want pure adrenaline and don't mind a thin story, you'll have a blast. It's best enjoyed streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting on Apple TV for a weekend movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the asset was never truly on your side. He was playing the team the whole time, and the mission was a setup from the start. Most of the operatives are killed during the ambush. Silva survives and is approached by a shadowy group called Overwatch, who recruit him for future missions. The movie ends on a cliffhanger, hinting that the real fight is just beginning and leaving the door open for a sequel.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-octane action and military thrillers.
